verses.en: Ha Mim

verses.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحۡمٰنِ الرَّحِيۡمِۚ‏
verses.en: A Revelation from (Allah), Most Gracious, Most Merciful

verses.ar: كِتٰبٌ فُصِّلَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗ قُرۡاٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: A Book, whereof the verses are explained in detail;- a Qur'an in Arabic, for people who understand

verses.ar: بَشِيۡرًا وَّنَذِيۡرًاۚ فَاَعۡرَضَ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: Giving good news and admonition: yet most of them turn away, and so they hear not

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا قُلُوۡبُنَا فِيۡ٘ اَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدۡعُوۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِ وَفِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِنَا وَقۡرٌ وَّمِنۭۡ بَيۡنِنَا وَبَيۡنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعۡمَلۡ اِنَّنَا عٰمِلُوۡنَ
verses.en: They say: "Our hearts are under veils, (concealed) from that to which thou dost invite us, and in our ears in a deafness, and between us and thee is a screen: so do thou (what thou wilt); for us, we shall do (what we will)

verses.ar: قُلۡ اِنَّمَا٘ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُكُمۡ يُوۡحٰ٘ي اِلَيَّ اَنَّمَا٘ اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسۡتَقِيۡمُوۡ٘ا اِلَيۡهِ وَاسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡهُؕ وَوَيۡلٌ لِّلۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: Say thou: "I am but a man like you: It is revealed to me by Inspiration, that your Allah is one Allah: so stand true to Him, and ask for His Forgiveness." And woe to those who join gods with Allah

verses.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡتُوۡنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَهُمۡ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمۡ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Those who practise not regular Charity, and who even deny the Hereafter

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمۡ اَجۡرٌ غَيۡرُ مَمۡنُوۡنٍࣖ‏
verses.en: For those who believe and work deeds of righteousness is a reward that will never fail

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَئِنَّكُمۡ لَتَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِالَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَرۡضَ فِيۡ يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَتَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لَهٗ٘ اَنۡدَادًاؕ ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Say: Is it that ye deny Him Who created the earth in two Days? And do ye join equals with Him? He is the Lord of (all) the Worlds

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ فِيۡهَا رَوَاسِيَ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهَا وَبٰرَكَ فِيۡهَا وَقَدَّرَ فِيۡهَا٘ اَقۡوَاتَهَا فِيۡ٘ اَرۡبَعَةِ اَيَّامٍؕ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِيۡنَ
verses.en: He set on the (earth), mountains standing firm, high above it, and bestowed blessings on the earth, and measure therein all things to give them nourishment in due proportion, in four Days, in accordance with (the needs of) those who seek (Sustenance)

verses.ar: ثُمَّ اسۡتَوٰ٘ي اِلَي السَّمَآءِ وَهِيَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَلِلۡاَرۡضِ ائۡتِيَا طَوۡعًا اَوۡ كَرۡهًاؕ قَالَتَا٘ اَتَيۡنَا طَآئِعِيۡنَ
verses.en: Moreover He comprehended in His design the sky, and it had been (as) smoke: He said to it and to the earth: "Come ye together, willingly or unwillingly." They said: "We do come (together), in willing obedience

verses.ar: فَقَضٰىهُنَّ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِيۡ يَوۡمَيۡنِ وَاَوۡحٰي فِيۡ كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ اَمۡرَهَا وَزَيَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنۡيَا بِمَصَابِيۡحَࣗۖ وَحِفۡظًاؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِ
verses.en: So He completed them as seven firmaments in two Days, and He assigned to each heaven its duty and command. And We adorned the lower heaven with lights, and (provided it) with guard. Such is the Decree of (Him) the Exalted in Might, Full of Knowledge

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ اَعۡرَضُوۡا فَقُلۡ اَنۡذَرۡتُكُمۡ صٰعِقَةً مِّثۡلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّثَمُوۡدَؕ‏
verses.en: But if they turn away, say thou: "I have warned you of a stunning Punishment (as of thunder and lightning) like that which (overtook) the 'Ad and the Thamud

verses.ar: اِذۡ جَآءَتۡهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ اَلَّا تَعۡبُدُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا اللّٰهَؕ قَالُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنۡزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً فَاِنَّا بِمَا٘ اُرۡسِلۡتُمۡ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
verses.en: Behold, the messengers came to them, from before them and behind them, (preaching): "Serve none but Allah." They said, "If our Lord had so pleased, He would certainly have sent down angels (to preach). Now we reject your mission (altogether)

verses.ar: فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَقَالُوۡا مَنۡ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةًؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَهُمۡ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةًؕ وَكَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Now the 'Ad behaved arrogantly through the land, against (all) truth and reason, and said: "Who is superior to us in strength?" What! did they not see that Allah, Who created them, was superior to them in strength? But they continued to reject Our Signs

verses.ar: فَاَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِيۡ٘ اَيَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِيۡقَهُمۡ عَذَابَ الۡخِزۡيِ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَخۡزٰي وَهُمۡ لَا يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
verses.en: So We sent against them a furious Wind through days of disaster, that We might give them a taste of a Penalty of humiliation in this life; but the Penalty of a Hereafter will be more humiliating still: and they will find no help

verses.ar: وَاَمَّا ثَمُوۡدُ فَهَدَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَاسۡتَحَبُّوا الۡعَمٰي عَلَي الۡهُدٰي فَاَخَذَتۡهُمۡ صٰعِقَةُ الۡعَذَابِ الۡهُوۡنِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: As to the Thamud, We gave them Guidance, but they preferred blindness (of heart) to Guidance: so the stunning Punishment of humiliation seized them, because of what they had earned

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيۡنَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَكَانُوۡا يَتَّقُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: But We delivered those who believed and practised righteousness

verses.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُحۡشَرُ اَعۡدَآءُ اللّٰهِ اِلَي النَّارِ فَهُمۡ يُوۡزَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: On the Day that the enemies of Allah will be gathered together to the Fire, they will be marched in ranks

verses.ar: حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا مَا جَآءُوۡهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَاَبۡصَارُهُمۡ وَجُلُوۡدُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: At length, when they reach the (Fire), their hearing, their sight, and their skins will bear witness against them, as to (all) their deeds

verses.ar: وَقَالُوۡا لِجُلُوۡدِهِمۡ لِمَ شَهِدۡتُّمۡ عَلَيۡنَاؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَنۡطَقَنَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡطَقَ كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُوَ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
verses.en: They will say to their skins: "Why bear ye witness against us?" They will say: "Allah hath given us speech,- (He) Who giveth speech to everything: He created you for the first time, and unto Him were ye to return

verses.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَسۡتَتِرُوۡنَ اَنۡ يَّشۡهَدَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ سَمۡعُكُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَبۡصَارُكُمۡ وَلَا جُلُوۡدُكُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ ظَنَنۡتُمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَعۡلَمُ كَثِيۡرًا مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: Ye did not seek to hide yourselves, lest your hearing, your sight, and your skins should bear witness against you! But ye did think that Allah knew not many of the things that ye used to do

verses.ar: وَذٰلِكُمۡ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِيۡ ظَنَنۡتُمۡ بِرَبِّكُمۡ اَرۡدٰىكُمۡ فَاَصۡبَحۡتُمۡ مِّنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
verses.en: But this thought of yours which ye did entertain concerning your Lord, hath brought you to destruction, and (now) have ye become of those utterly lost

verses.ar: فَاِنۡ يَّصۡبِرُوۡا فَالنَّارُ مَثۡوًي لَّهُمۡؕ وَاِنۡ يَّسۡتَعۡتِبُوۡا فَمَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمُعۡتَبِيۡنَ
verses.en: If, then, they have patience, the Fire will be a home for them! and if they beg to be received into favour, into favour will they not (then) be received

verses.ar: وَقَيَّضۡنَا لَهُمۡ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَيَّنُوۡا لَهُمۡ مَّا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلُ فِيۡ٘ اُمَمٍ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِۚ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا خٰسِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: And We have destined for them intimate companions (of like nature), who made alluring to them what was before them and behind them; and the sentence among the previous generations of Jinns and men, who have passed away, is proved against them; for they are utterly lost

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَا تَسۡمَعُوۡا لِهٰذَا الۡقُرۡاٰنِ وَالۡغَوۡا فِيۡهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: The Unbelievers say: "Listen not to this Qur'an, but talk at random in the midst of its (reading), that ye may gain the upper hand

verses.ar: فَلَنُذِيۡقَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًا وَّلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ اَسۡوَاَ الَّذِيۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
verses.en: But We will certainly give the Unbelievers a taste of a severe Penalty, and We will requite them for the worst of their deeds

verses.ar: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ اَعۡدَآءِ اللّٰهِ النَّارُۚ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا دَارُ الۡخُلۡدِؕ جَزَآءًۭ بِمَا كَانُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Such is the requital of the enemies of Allah,- the Fire: therein will be for them the Eternal Home: a (fit) requital, for that they were wont to reject Our Signs

verses.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا رَبَّنَا٘ اَرِنَا الَّذَيۡنِ اَضَلّٰنَا مِنَ الۡجِنِّ وَالۡاِنۡسِ نَجۡعَلۡهُمَا تَحۡتَ اَقۡدَامِنَا لِيَكُوۡنَا مِنَ الۡاَسۡفَلِيۡنَ
verses.en: And the Unbelievers will say: "Our Lord! Show us those, among Jinns and men, who misled us: We shall crush them beneath our feet, so that they become the vilest (before all)

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اسۡتَقَامُوۡا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَلَّا تَخَافُوۡا وَلَا تَحۡزَنُوۡا وَاَبۡشِرُوۡا بِالۡجَنَّةِ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
verses.en: In the case of those who say, "Our Lord is Allah", and, further, stand straight and steadfast, the angels descend on them (from time to time): "Fear ye not!" (they suggest), "Nor grieve! but receive the Glad Tidings of the Garden (of Bliss), the which ye were promised

verses.ar: نَحۡنُ اَوۡلِيٰٓـُٔكُمۡ فِي الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَفِي الۡاٰخِرَةِۚ وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا تَشۡتَهِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسُكُمۡ وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا تَدَّعُوۡنَؕ‏
verses.en: We are your protectors in this life and in the Hereafter: therein shall ye have all that your souls shall desire; therein shall ye have all that ye ask for

verses.ar: نُزُلًا مِّنۡ غَفُوۡرٍ رَّحِيۡمٍࣖ‏
verses.en: A hospitable gift from one Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ اَحۡسَنُ قَوۡلًا مِّمَّنۡ دَعَا٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَّقَالَ اِنَّنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: Who is better in speech than one who calls (men) to Allah, works righteousness, and says, "I am of those who bow in Islam

verses.ar: وَلَا تَسۡتَوِي الۡحَسَنَةُ وَلَا السَّيِّئَةُؕ اِدۡفَعۡ بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِيۡ بَيۡنَكَ وَبَيۡنَهٗ عَدَاوَةٌ كَاَنَّهٗ وَلِيٌّ حَمِيۡمٌ
verses.en: Nor can goodness and Evil be equal. Repel (Evil) with what is better: Then will he between whom and thee was hatred become as it were thy friend and intimate

verses.ar: وَمَا يُلَقّٰىهَا٘ اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡاۚ وَمَا يُلَقّٰىهَا٘ اِلَّا ذُوۡ حَظٍّ عَظِيۡمٍ
verses.en: And no one will be granted such goodness except those who exercise patience and self-restraint,- none but persons of the greatest good fortune

verses.ar: وَاِمَّا يَنۡزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ نَزۡغٌ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
verses.en: And if (at any time) an incitement to discord is made to thee by the Evil One, seek refuge in Allah. He is the One Who hears and knows all things

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهِ الَّيۡلُ وَالنَّهَارُ وَالشَّمۡسُ وَالۡقَمَرُؕ لَا تَسۡجُدُوۡا لِلشَّمۡسِ وَلَا لِلۡقَمَرِ وَاسۡجُدُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَهُنَّ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
verses.en: Among His Signs are the Night and the Day, and the Sun and the Moon. Do not prostrate to the sun and the moon, but prostrate to Allah, Who created them, if it is Him ye wish to serve

verses.ar: فَاِنِ اسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا فَالَّذِيۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكَ يُسَبِّحُوۡنَ لَهٗ بِالَّيۡلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡـَٔمُوۡنَࣛ‏
verses.en: But is the (Unbelievers) are arrogant, (no matter): for in the presence of thy Lord are those who celebrate His praises by night and by day. And they never flag (nor feel themselves above it)

verses.ar: وَمِنۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ٘ اَنَّكَ تَرَي الۡاَرۡضَ خَاشِعَةً فَاِذَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهَا الۡمَآءَ اهۡتَزَّتۡ وَرَبَتۡؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَحۡيَاهَا لَمُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰيؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
verses.en: And among His Signs in this: thou seest the earth barren and desolate; but when We send down rain to it, it is stirred to life and yields increase. Truly, He Who gives life to the (dead) earth can surely give life to (men) who are dead. For He has power over all things

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يُلۡحِدُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰيٰتِنَا لَا يَخۡفَوۡنَ عَلَيۡنَاؕ اَفَمَنۡ يُّلۡقٰي فِي النَّارِ خَيۡرٌ اَمۡ مَّنۡ يَّاۡتِيۡ٘ اٰمِنًا يَّوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِؕ اِعۡمَلُوۡا مَا شِئۡتُمۡۙ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ بَصِيۡرٌ
verses.en: Those who pervert the Truth in Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Which is better?- he that is cast into the Fire, or he that comes safe through, on the Day of Judgment? Do what ye will: verily He seeth (clearly) all that ye do

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِالذِّكۡرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡۚ وَاِنَّهٗ لَكِتٰبٌ عَزِيۡزٌۙ‏
verses.en: Those who reject the Message when it comes to them (are not hidden from Us). And indeed it is a Book of exalted power

verses.ar: لَّا يَاۡتِيۡهِ الۡبَاطِلُ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ يَدَيۡهِ وَلَا مِنۡ خَلۡفِهٖؕ تَنۡزِيۡلٌ مِّنۡ حَكِيۡمٍ حَمِيۡدٍ
verses.en: No falsehood can approach it from before or behind it: It is sent down by One Full of Wisdom, Worthy of all Praise

verses.ar: مَا يُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدۡ قِيۡلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوۡ مَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّذُوۡ عِقَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
verses.en: Nothing is said to thee that was not said to the messengers before thee: that thy lord has at his Command (all) forgiveness as well as a most Grievous Penalty

verses.ar: وَلَوۡ جَعَلۡنٰهُ قُرۡاٰنًا اَعۡجَمِيًّا لَّقَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا فُصِّلَتۡ اٰيٰتُهٗؕ ءَاَۙعۡجَمِيٌّ وَّعَرَبِيٌّؕ قُلۡ هُوَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا هُدًي وَّشِفَآءٌؕ وَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَقۡرٌ وَّهُوَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ عَمًيؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ يُنَادَوۡنَ مِنۡ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍࣖ‏
verses.en: Had We sent this as a Qur'an (in the language) other than Arabic, they would have said: "Why are not its verses explained in detail? What! (a Book) not in Arabic and (a Messenger an Arab?" Say: "It is a Guide and a Healing to those who believe; and for those who believe not, there is a deafness in their ears, and it is blindness in their (eyes): They are (as it were) being called from a place far distant

verses.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ فَاخۡتُلِفَ فِيۡهِؕ وَلَوۡلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتۡ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِيَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ وَاِنَّهُمۡ لَفِيۡ شَكٍّ مِّنۡهُ مُرِيۡبٍ
verses.en: We certainly gave Moses the Book aforetime: but disputes arose therein. Had it not been for a Word that went forth before from thy Lord, (their differences) would have been settled between them: but they remained in suspicious disquieting doubt thereon

verses.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفۡسِهٖۚ وَمَنۡ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاؕ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلۡعَبِيۡدِ
verses.en: Whoever works righteousness benefits his own soul; whoever works evil, it is against his own soul: nor is thy Lord ever unjust (in the least) to His Servants

verses.ar: اِلَيۡهِ يُرَدُّ عِلۡمُ السَّاعَةِؕ وَمَا تَخۡرُجُ مِنۡ ثَمَرٰتٍ مِّنۡ اَكۡمَامِهَا وَمَا تَحۡمِلُ مِنۡ اُنۡثٰي وَلَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلۡمِهٖؕ وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيۡۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰذَنّٰكَۙ مَامِنَّا مِنۡ شَهِيۡدٍۚ‏
verses.en: To Him is referred the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment: He knows all): No date-fruit comes out of its sheath, nor does a female conceive (within her womb) nor bring forth the Day that (Allah) will propound to them the (question), "Where are the partners (ye attributed to Me?" They will say, "We do assure thee not one of us can bear witness)

verses.ar: وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ وَظَنُّوۡا مَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّحِيۡصٍ
verses.en: The (deities) they used to invoke aforetime will leave them in the lurch, and they will perceive that they have no way of escape

verses.ar: لَا يَسۡـَٔمُ الۡاِنۡسَانُ مِنۡ دُعَآءِ الۡخَيۡرِؗ وَاِنۡ مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوۡسٌ قَنُوۡطٌ
verses.en: Man does not weary of asking for good (things), but if ill touches him, he gives up all hope (and) is lost in despair

verses.ar: وَلَئِنۡ اَذَقۡنٰهُ رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتۡهُ لَيَقُوۡلَنَّ هٰذَا لِيۡۙ وَمَا٘ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةًۙ وَّلَئِنۡ رُّجِعۡتُ اِلٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اِنَّ لِيۡ عِنۡدَهٗ لَلۡحُسۡنٰيۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِمَا عَمِلُوۡاؗ وَلَنُذِيۡقَنَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ عَذَابٍ غَلِيۡظٍ
verses.en: When we give him a taste of some Mercy from Ourselves, after some adversity has touched him, he is sure to say, "This is due to my (merit): I think not that the Hour (of Judgment) will (ever) be established; but if I am brought back to my Lord, I have (much) good (stored) in His sight!" But We will show the Unbelievers the truth of all that they did, and We shall give them the taste of a severe Penalty

verses.ar: وَاِذَا٘ اَنۡعَمۡنَا عَلَي الۡاِنۡسَانِ اَعۡرَضَ وَنَاٰبِجَانِبِهٖۚ وَاِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُوۡ دُعَآءٍ عَرِيۡضٍ
verses.en: When We bestow favours on man, he turns away, and gets himself remote on his side (instead of coming to Us); and when evil seizes him, (he comes) full of prolonged prayer

verses.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ كَانَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرۡتُمۡ بِهٖ مَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ فِيۡ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيۡدٍ
verses.en: Say: "See ye if the (Revelation) is (really) from Allah, and yet do ye reject it? Who is more astray than one who is in a schism far (from any purpose)

verses.ar: سَنُرِيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَا فِي الۡاٰفَاقِ وَفِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ حَتّٰي يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمۡ اَنَّهُ الۡحَقُّؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفِ بِرَبِّكَ اَنَّهٗ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ شَهِيۡدٌ
verses.en: Soon will We show them our Signs in the (furthest) regions (of the earth), and in their own souls, until it becomes manifest to them that this is the Truth. Is it not enough that thy Lord doth witness all things

verses.ar: اَلَا٘ اِنَّهُمۡ فِيۡ مِرۡيَةٍ مِّنۡ لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمۡؕ اَلَا٘ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ مُّحِيۡطٌࣖ‏
verses.en: Ah indeed! Are they in doubt concerning the Meeting with their Lord? Ah indeed! It is He that doth encompass all things
